```sql
SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
FROM main."Player_Attributes"
WHERE date <= '2013-12-25'
  AND player_api_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM (
      SELECT player_api_id, date,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC) as rn
      FROM main."Player_Attributes"
      WHERE date <= '2013-12-25'
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
  )
  AND (player_api_id, date) IN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date)
    FROM main."Player_Attributes"
    WHERE date <= '2013-12-25'
    GROUP BY player_api_id
  )
```
